questions.text: In the Delhi Legislative Assembly election held on 5 February 2025, which party emerged victorious?

options.text: Bharatiya Janata Party Question Type : MCQ

questions.text: A manufacturer sells a product to a wholesaler at a profit of 25%. The wholesaler, in turn, sells it to a retailer at a profit of 28%, and the retailer sells it to a customer at a profit of 25%. If the customer pays ₹122, find the cost price (in ₹) for the manufacturer.
Regarding the relationship between the Fundamental Rights (FR) and the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP) in India, which of the following assertions is true?

options.text: DPSP are justiciable and can override FR when necessary.
Both serve as independent pillars; however, FR are legally enforceable while DPSP cannot be.
FR are subordinate to DPSP in case of any conflict.
DPSP can be enforced directly in the courts, similar to FR. Question Type : MCQ

questions.text: 5 bags and 18 pens together cost ₹1710, whereas 4 bags and 13 pens together cost ₹1256. The cost of 12 bags exceeds the cost of 6 pens by:
